core_research_thesis: Designing a scalable, fault-tolerant quantum internet architecture over continental distances without trusted repeater stations, leveraging quantum error correction and secure quantum key distribution
state_of_the_art_prior_art: Quantum teleportation protocols for long-distance quantum communication
Surface code and concatenated code implementations for quantum error correction
Quantum key distribution protocols like BB84 and Ekert91 for secure key exchange
Distributed quantum network architectures with entanglement-based connections
proven_facts: Quantum No-Cloning Theorem limits the amplification of quantum signals
Heisenberg Uncertainty Principle imposes fundamental limits on quantum measurement precision
Shannon-Hartley Theorem for quantum channels bounds the capacity of quantum communication
Quantum Error Correction Codes can mitigate quantum noise in communication
critical_unanswered_unknowns: Scalable methods for distributing entanglement over continental distances without trusted repeaters
Robust quantum error correction techniques for high-speed, long-distance quantum communication
Security protocols for quantum key distribution that do not rely on trusted repeater stations
Impact of quantum noise on the performance of large-scale quantum networks

proposed_testable_hypotheses.Hypothesis 1: Entanglement-based quantum: Verification through experimental demonstration of entanglement distribution and quantum key distribution over long distances
proposed_testable_hypotheses.Hypothesis 2: Surface code-based quantum: Verification through simulation and experimental implementation of surface code correction in a quantum communication setup
proposed_testable_hypotheses.Hypothesis 3: Quantum key distribution p: Verification through theoretical analysis and experimental demonstration of device-independent quantum key distribution

failure_modes_and_risks: Quantum noise and error correction limitations
Scalability issues with current quantum network architectures
Security vulnerabilities due to trusted repeater stations
Interoperability challenges between different quantum systems and protocols
required_empirical_data_inputs: Experimental data on entanglement distribution and quantum key distribution over long distances
Characterization of quantum noise in various quantum communication channels
Performance metrics of quantum error correction codes in different scenarios
Security analysis of device-independent quantum key distribution protocols
